witness.evidence: For q=3, sigma fixes0 and swaps1,2, so no centralizer permutation can send0 to1; the swap of y=(0,1) is not induced by the centralizer. Both are examples of the regularity failure expressly asserted by the quoted original; they are not defeaters of that assertion.
